subject: EdgeHealth pilot: MAP skeleton, evaluation checkpoints, and closure timetable
body:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Simon Park <simon@edgehealth.ai>, Tom Alvarez <t.alvarez@edgehealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeHealth pilot: MAP skeleton, evaluation checkpoints, and closure timetable

Hi Simon & Tom —

Thanks for the conversation last week. As discussed on the call, I’m sharing an initial MAP skeleton and a one-slide timeline to frame the pilot / evaluation window. The goal here is to get a short, actionable plan we can co-sign so procurement and engineering have a single source of truth for expectations and timelines.

Attached: MAP_Skeleton_v0.gdoc (editable), Pilot_Timeline_v0.gslides (slides stub).

High-level asks:
- Can you confirm acceptance criteria for the pilot (data slice, latency targets, sample workflows)?
- Who should we loop in from engineering for week0 validation (SSH/key access, sample dataset)?
- Any procurement constraints we should bake into the timeline (PO lead time, security review windows)?

Proposed quick cadence:
- Week 0 (tech kickoff): access, small-scale inference tests, baseline metrics capture
- Week 1 (pilot run): focused workflows with 1–2 teams, telemetry collection
- Week 2 (evaluation): quality review, cost/latency analysis, acceptance gate decision
- Week 3 (close/next steps): finalize purchase/order, roll plan for prod

I’ve put a draft acceptance checklist in the doc — feel free to add inline. Priyom, can you take point on drafting the test prompt set once Simon confirms the core workflows?

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Manager, Solutions
Redwood Inference

———

On Mon, 19 Jul 2027 at 10:05 AM Simon Park <simon@edgehealth.ai> wrote:
> From: Simon Park <simon@edgehealth.ai>
> To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
> Cc: Tom Alvarez <t.alvarez@edgehealth.ai>, EdgeHealth Procurement <procurement@edgehealth.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
> Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: EdgeHealth pilot: MAP skeleton, evaluation checkpoints, and closure timetable
>
> Mina — thanks, this looks like a good starting point. A few quick clarifications from our side:
>
> 1) Acceptance criteria: for us, the big items are (a) classification accuracy on the triage model at >= 88% on our holdout set, (b) median inference latency under 250ms for 90% of calls, and (c) no PHI leaves the VPC during test runs.
> 2) Tech contacts: Tom (cc’d) will coordinate infra and provide access. He’s also confirming whether we need a temporary VPN or if we can use the existing peering.
> 3) Procurement: procurement@edgehealth.ai — they’ll need an SOW-level doc and an estimated cost; FYI they have a standard 21-day vendor review cycle.
>
> We’ll review the doc and add comments inline by EOD Tuesday.
>
> —Simon

On Mon, 19 Jul 2027 at 11:00 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
> To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Simon Park <simon@edgehealth.ai>, Tom Alvarez <t.alvarez@edgehealth.ai>
> Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, EdgeHealth Procurement <procurement@edgehealth.ai>
> Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:00:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: EdgeHealth pilot: MAP skeleton, evaluation checkpoints, and closure timetable
>
> Thanks Mina — I reviewed the draft and added a few concrete checkpoints:
>
> - Week 0 deliverables (tech kickoff): sample dataset ingest (first 1k records), quick smoke validation (sanity checks), access matrix completed by Tom.
> - Week 1 deliverables (pilot run): 3 representative workflows validated, telemetry dashboard ingest, runbook for anomaly triage.
> - Week 2 deliverables (evaluation): consolidated QA report, token-cost projection for 30-day production, recommended quantization/throughput config.
>
> Suggested acceptance gate rubric (add to doc):
> - Quality: meets >= 88% on primary metrics OR agreed exception documented;
> - Performance: p90 latency under 350ms (we can tighten based on infra);
> - Security: no external data egress and logs retained per EdgeHealth retention policy.
>
> Tom — could you confirm who will handle the dataset drop and whether you need an S3 presign or direct upload?
>
> Priyom — can you schedule a 60–90 minute prompt design session with EdgeHealth engineers this week so we can seed the test set?
>
> Thanks — I’ll also add a short tech checklist slide into the timeline deck.
>
> Best,
>Marissa
>Senior Solutions Engineer
>Redwood Inference

>

> Great feedback — thanks all. I consolidated inline comments and created two live artifacts so we can co-edit:
>
> - MAP (editable): https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP_Skeleton_v0
> - One-slide timeline: https://drive.google.com/open?id=Pilot_Timeline_v0
>
> Next steps (action owners):
> - Tom (EdgeHealth): confirm dataset drop method & VPN/peering by EOD Wed 7/21
> - Priyom (Redwood): schedule prompt design session and seed test set by 7/22
> - Ben (Redwood): spin up infra runway and share VM flavors (done by 7/21)
> - Marissa (Redwood): add tech checklist slide and finalize acceptance rubric (7/21)
> - Procurement (EdgeHealth): confirm review cycle window & required SOW details (by 7/22)
>
> I’ll capture these in the doc and request a final review meeting Friday 7/23. If we’re aligned on acceptance gates and procurement timing we should be able to close contract discussions the following week.
>
> Attachments referenced: MAP_Skeleton_v0.gdoc, Pilot_Timeline_v0.gslides, Infra_Runbook.pdf
>
